translations.web: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.
translations.bsb: Like a muddied spring or a polluted well is a righteous man who gives way to the wicked.
translations.kjv: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.
translations.asv: As a troubled fountain, and a corrupted spring, So is a righteous man that giveth way before the wicked.
